messages:
maria: quick async standup — quick hits for SDKs/quickstarts/sample apps
maria: Did: updated Python quickstart to call out ESM vs CJS import patterns and added an M1 mac troubleshooting note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 :rocket:
maria: Blocked: the sampleapp mac wheels still fail in the release CI for arm64, see failing test `samples/embedding_test.py::test_embed_local` — can't reproduce locally on Intel so need someone with M1 to confirm.
maria: Today: want a quick review on the wording in the quickstart and a sanity-check run on M1 if anyone has one free.

Tom: I can take the PR review in ~30m, ping me when it's ready. quick glance — did you bump the sdk client minimum version?

maria: @tom yes, bumped to 0.8.4 in the examples, left a note in the changelog.

Sanjay: CI note — the mac arm64 runner is flaky because of a brew dependency timing out. I've queued a rerun and added a 30s retry for `brew install` in the job.

Sanjay: If you want to reproduce locally on M1, run:
```bash
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e sdk/python
pip install -r samples/requirements.txt\pytest samples/embedding_test.py::test_embed_local -q
```

elaine: I ran the sample locally on my MBP (M1) and hit the same failure — looks like the local tokenizer wheel falls back to a source build. I pushed a small patch to the sampleapp to pin `tokenizers==0.13.3` which fixed my run. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/298

maria: great — thanks @elaine. I'll merge the docs PR once @tom approves and then sync the quickstart to reference the samples PR.

ryan (devex): quick heads-up — we just cut a canary SDK build (0.8.5-canary) that includes the ESM import helpers. If anyone wants to try without changing their pinned version, use `pip install redwood-sdk==0.8.5-canary` in the sample venv.

ryan (devex): also, small reminder: update the quickstart code blocks to include the streaming example we landed last week, otherwise examples diverge. I can open a tiny PR for that if you want.

maria: please do, @ryan. Saves me a follow-up.

deploy-bot: deploy queued — docs-staging -> preview (build 4271) :white_check_mark:

Tom: Reviewed and left one nits-only comment on the phrasing. LGTM after that.

maria: thanks all — action items: merge samples PR (elaine), merge docs PR (maria after tom's nit), monitor CI rerun (sanjay). If CI still flakes, we'll temporarily pin tokenizers in the quickstart and call out the known issue in the release notes.

elaine: I can merge the samples PR after CI green. Will ping here when done. :thumbsup:

Sanjay: rerun passed, tagging the arm64 matrix as flaky-notes in the job.

maria: last — small UX ask: can we add a one-line note in the quickstart about how to run the sample locally (the three-line command above)? saves a lot of back-and-forth for new contributors.

ryan (devex): agreed — adding that now.

maria: thanks everyone, closing out my blockers.
